image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a Cavalier King Charles Spaniel (Blenheim variety) lying on a textured grey blanket. The dog has a white face with a distinct chestnut blaze between the eyes and large chestnut ears. It is resting its chin on its paws, looking directly at the camera. The background consists of vertical wooden slats.
